clips.title: Completion
paras: The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?
This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.
